fixes.problem: LOOMORA_FMT_LSEEK64 (API < 21) called pread64, pwrite64, fstat64 and used struct stat64: undeclared with the r15c unified headers (pread64 and pwrite64 from API 12, fstat64 from API 21), and absent from the libc of API 9 to 11
fixes.fix: API < 12: the pread64 / pwrite64 system calls through syscall() (ARM EABI: one padding argument before the 64-bit offset); API < 21: fstat() and struct stat, whose st_size is already 64 bits in these headers; API 12 to 20: pread64 / pwrite64. Only the Android API < 21 branches changed

fixes.problem: the gnustl of the NDK has neither std::to_string nor std::snprintf (_GLIBCXX_USE_C99 undefined)
fixes.fix: a local dec() helper and the global snprintf; same messages on every target

fixes.problem: loomora_refgen was not built for Android; the Android build did not copy the format self-test
fixes.fix: loomora_refgen is built for the NDK toolchain; tools/build.py copies loomora_format_selftest and loomora_refgen into out/android-legacy/selftest/<abi>/

fixes.problem: Android 5.0+ refuses a non-PIE executable (error: only position independent executables (PIE) are supported); no x86_64 ABI
fixes.fix: parameter LOOMORA_ANDROID_PIE (ON adds -fPIE and -pie, needs API >= 16) and ABI x86_64 (API 21 sysroot); default unchanged, so the API 9 test programs and the APK libraries are built as before. Only the test programs of API >= 21 devices use it (a toolchain parameter, not a code fallback)

fixes.problem: the Gradle build of the Modern UI could not find rapidjson/document.h or build zlib: its source directory is not the repository root
fixes.fix: the Modern CMakeLists sets LOOMORA_ZLIB_DIR and LOOMORA_RAPIDJSON_DIR and includes cmake/loomora_zlib.cmake; the two files take the variables when they are already set (default unchanged)

fixes.problem: the Android launchers had no project modes ('this launcher has no project modes')
fixes.fix: AndroidLegacyLauncher.run_project (the Modern launcher inherits it): pushes the file to /data/local/tmp, starts the activity without -W (a project mode finishes its activity at once, `am start -W` then never returns), reads the LOOMORA_VALIDATE line, removes the device directory from the file name in the line, infers the exit status from the line (android_project_status: an activity has no exit status), and waits for the activity to end for the usage rows; self-tested
